mentions.name: Human-in-the-loop agent assignment grader
mentions.description: A human-in-the-loop grading tool built on top of the Claude Agent SDK that helps TAs grade student agent-development assignments. Phase 1 downloads the student's code from their submitted GitHub repo URL and runs a series of skill-defined extractions (e.g., presence of a README.md, few-shot examples in the prompt), saving results to a JSON blob. Phase 2 generates probe queries from the agent's system prompt and runs the student's agent locally against those probes, saving queries and results. Phase 3 surfaces subjective items to the TA for 1–5 grading. The rubric is 50% objective and 50% subjective, all driven by the agent.
mentions.audience: TAs and course staff grading a university agent development class
mentions.source_excerpt: First assignment is in and I'm writing a human-in-the-loop grader for my TAs to use that's built on top of Claude Agent SDK.
